definitions.gloss: enlargement; supplementing; adding material (to a book)
definitions.explanation: Adding new material to a book or document that has already been published, to produce a larger edition. Seen mostly on book covers and in publishing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{増補版|ぞうほばん}→増補版：24013_zouhoban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An enlarged edition has come out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初版|しょはん}→初版：15827_shohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増補|ぞうほ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new chapter was added to the first edition.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改訂|かいてい}→改訂：13044_kaitei⟧{増補|ぞうほ}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{新語|しんご}→新語：21555_shingo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二千|にせん}→二千：00976_nisen⟧⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧⟦{加|くわ}わった→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: The dictionary was revised and enlarged for the first time in ten years, adding two thousand new words.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{増補版|ぞうほばん}→増補版：24013_zouhoban⟧: enlarged edition
- {改訂増補|かいていぞうほ} / {増補改訂|ぞうほかいてい}: revised and enlarged
- {新装増補|しんそうぞうほ}: new and enlarged edition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改訂|かいてい}→改訂：13044_kaitei⟧: revision, correcting or updating the existing text; {増補|ぞうほ} adds to it
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧: a supplement or added explanation in general, not tied to books
